name: Diana
overview: The Bible presents Diana as the great goddess worshipped by the people of Ephesus, whose temple was central to their religious and economic life. Acts 19 records the strong devotion of the Ephesian people to Diana, highlighting how her worship supported local craftsmen who made silver shrines in her honor and how the threat to her temple stirred great public outrage. The city clerk's recognition of Diana's significance underscores her deep cultural influence, yet this narrative also reveals the tension between Christian truth and idolatrous worship in the early church.
